name: quality-transformation-coach-mcp
description: MCP server for software quality transformation coaching — 14 tools for code analysis, CI/CD health, defect trends, maturity assessments (TMMi/ISO 25010), quality gates, and reporting.
long_description: A knowledge-based MCP server for software quality transformation, providing tools for both the quality coach (overviews, maturity assessments, reporting) and the development/test team (code analysis, CI/CD insights, test support).

tools.name: analyze_code_quality
tools.description: Scan a repository for code quality metrics (complexity, duplication, smells)

tools.name: analyze_test_coverage
tools.description: Analyze test coverage by comparing test files against source files

tools.name: detect_test_patterns
tools.description: Detect test patterns and anti-patterns in a repository

tools.name: analyze_flaky_tests
tools.description: Detect flaky tests from CI run data

tools.name: defect_trend_analysis
tools.description: Analyze issue trends (volume, resolution time, severity)

tools.name: quality_hotspot_detection
tools.description: Identify files with the highest defect density

tools.name: root_cause_categories
tools.description: Categorise closed bugs by root cause

tools.name: pipeline_health
tools.description: Analyze CI/CD pipeline health (success rate, duration)

tools.name: test_result_summary
tools.description: Get test results summary for a CI workflow run

tools.name: quality_gate_check
tools.description: Check if quality gates are met

tools.name: framework_lookup
tools.description: Look up ISO 25010 or TMMi frameworks

tools.name: generate_quality_report
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive Markdown quality report
